domain.rationale: It serves as the identifier for a specific set of private DNS records that Apigee needs to access, such as internal backend service hostnames

description.rationale: It is the metadata used to describe zone and has no security impact

peering_config.description: Peering zone config Structure is [documented below](#nested_peering_config).
peering_config.rationale: This configuration allows the Apigee runtime instances to resolve internal hostnames and access backend services

target_project_id.description: The ID of the project that contains the producer VPC network.

target_network_id.description: The name of the producer VPC network.

org_id.description: The Apigee Organization associated with the Apigee instance, in the format `organizations/{{org_name}}`.
org_id.rationale: It sets organization name and has no security impact

dns_zone_id.rationale: It acts as the key for a DNS peering configuration that tells Apigee how to resolve hostnames within a specific private DNS zone and does not necessary have security impact.
